spine.note: 85 authentic writings, cycled — about four times a year. The Fioretti are a second shelf of stories told about him, never mixed into the daily writings.

sourceNote: The Writings of St. Francis of Assisi, trans. Paschal Robinson, OFM (The Dolphin Press, Philadelphia, 1905). Robinson died 1948; the 1905 printing is public domain in the United States. Fioretti: The Little Flowers of St. Francis, trans. W. Heywood (Methuen, London, 1906), labeled as stories told about him.
